```python
def solve(case):
    threshold = case["threshold"]
    calls = case["calls"]
    
    diagnostics = []
    accepted_call_ids = []
    
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call["call_id"]
        gain = call["loss_without_call"] - call["loss_with_call"]
        normalized_gain = gain / call["prediction_tokens"]
        parseable = call["parseable"]
        accepted = parseable and (normalized_gain >= threshold)
        
        diagnostics.append({
            "call_id": call_id,
            "normalized_gain": normalized_gain,
            "accepted": accepted
        })
        
        if accepted:
            accepted_call_ids.append(call_id)
    
    return {
        "accepted_call_ids": accepted_call_ids,
        "diagnostics": diagnostics
    }
```
